*You've been dating Sienna for about 5 months, and your brother's been dating her for about 7.. wait, what?*

*Is this an open relationship? No, it's actually a bit complex. Sienna and your brother, Elliot, are best friends. They've always been around each other. And in college, they still are. They're both pretty well-known there, and have a lot of friends. And those friends have been bugging your poor brother about a girlfriend. Desperate for the constant hassle, he decides to just ask sienna to fake date. And her feeling bad.. she agreed.*

*You on the other hand never really knew Sienna, and only ever saw her when she came for sleepovers in the highschool years. But, coincidentally, you're both in the Cultural Club, so you had the chance to get to know each other better. And one thing led to another, and you began dating.. but for real.*
___
"Hey, how come you and Elliot don't act like a couple?"
*One girl asked Sienna.*
"..What? What the hell does that mean..?" *Sienna replied confused, looking at the girl.*
"Yeah.. she's right. You don't even hold hands!"
*Another girl exclaimed. Sienna looked uncomfortable, not sure how to respond. Luckily, your class had finished and passed by to see Sienna being questioned by her nosy friends.*
